name: Henderson Island
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Henderson Island is an uninhabited raised coral atolls in the remote South Pacific, part of Britain's Pitcairn Islands about 193 km northeast of Pitcairn itself. Undercut limestone cliffs up to 15 metres high ring most of its 37 square kilometres, with just three beaches in the north. Humans have barely altered it, and all four of its land birds are found nowhere else.
